parameters.name: flags

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the status after waiting for a message

function.name: normalize_std_handle
function.description: This function checks if the input handle matches any of the standard handles (input, output, error). If it does, it returns the corresponding handle from the current thread's environment block. If it doesn't match any, it returns the input handle itself.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The handle that needs to be normalized

function.return_type: HANDLE, represents the normalized standard handle

function.name: NtUserMsgWaitForMultipleObjectsEx
function.description: This function waits for multiple objects and returns when either any one or all of the objects are in the signaled state, or the time-out interval elapses.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of object handles in the array.

parameters.name: handles
parameters.description: An array of object handles.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The time-out interval, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: The mask to be used.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The flags to be used.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the status after waiting for objects. It can be WAIT_FAILED in case of error or the index of the object that satisfied the wait.

function.name: NtUserWaitForInputIdle
function.description: This function waits for the specified process to become idle or until the time-out interval elapses. It is used in the Windows operating system to wait for a process to finish its initialization and enter the idle state.

parameters.name: process
parameters.description: A handle to the process.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The time-out interval, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: wow
parameters.description: A boolean value that indicates whether the function should wait for a 16-bit process (if set to TRUE) or a 32-bit process (if set to FALSE).

function.return_type: DWORD. It returns 0 if the function succeeds, WAIT_TIMEOUT if the function times out, and WAIT_FAILED if the function fails.

function.name: NtUserWaitMessage
function.description: This function waits for a message to arrive and then returns. It uses the NtUserMsgWaitForMultipleObjectsEx function to wait for multiple objects and checks if the wait was not failed.
function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the wait for the message was successful or not. If the wait was not failed, it returns TRUE, otherwise FALSE.

function.name: NtUserPeekMessage
function.description: This function peeks at the messages in the message queue, checks for driver events, and copies back the internal safe copy of message data to msg_out. It also handles the case where msg_out is NULL, setting the last Win32 error to ERROR_NOACCESS and returning FALSE.

parameters.name: msg_out
parameters.description: Pointer to a MSG structure that receives message information

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose messages are to be examined

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Specifies the value of the first message in the range of messages to be examined

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: Specifies the value of the last message in the range of messages to be examined

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies how messages are to be handled

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if a message is available and FALSE otherwise

function.name: NtUserGetMessage
function.description: This function retrieves a message from the calling thread's message queue and places it in the specified structure. The function also checks for certain types of messages and modifies a mask accordingly.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Pointer to an MSG structure that receives message information from the thread's message queue.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window whose messages are to be retrieved.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: The integer value of the first message in the range of messages to be examined.

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: The integer value of the last message in the range of messages to be examined.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns a nonzero value if a message is available and the function places the message in the msg parameter. The function returns zero if no messages are available or if an error occurs.

function.name: put_message_in_queue
function.description: This function is used to put a message into a queue. It handles different types of messages and applies different logic based on the type of the message. It also checks for timeout and sets it to infinite if not specified. It packs the message data and sends the message to the server.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a struct that contains information about the message to be sent.

parameters.name: reply_size
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a variable where the size of the reply will be stored.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the message is successfully put in the queue, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: post_dde_message_call
function.description: This function posts a DDE message call, setting up the request parameters and making a server call.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window for the DDE message.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be posted.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure containing the parameters for the DDE message call.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, representing the status of the operation.

function.name: wait_message_reply
function.description: This function waits for a message reply from a server queue. It continuously checks the queue bits and processes sent messages immediately. The function returns when it receives a result.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: This parameter is used to determine the wake mask. If the SMTO_BLOCK flag is set, the function will not block; otherwise, it will.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but rather performs an operation

function.name: retrieve_reply
function.description: This function retrieves a reply from a server request, unpacks the reply if it exists and sets the last error if there was a status error.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing information about the message to be sent

parameters.name: reply_size
parameters.description: Size of the reply to be retrieved

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the result of the function will be stored

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. Returns 0 if there was no status error, otherwise returns non-zero.

function.name: send_inter_thread_message
function.description: This function sends a message between threads, checks if the message is put in the queue, and retrieves the reply if necessary.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the information about the message to be sent.

parameters.name: res_ptr
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the result of the message retrieval.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the message sending operation. It returns 0 if the message is not put in the queue, 1 if there's no reply to wait for on notify/callback messages, and the result of the retrieve_reply function otherwise.

function.name: send_inter_thread_callback
function.description: This function assigns values to the members of the send_message_info structure and then calls the send_inter_thread_message function.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be sent.

parameters.name: wp
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lp
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to the result value.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: A pointer to a send_message_info structure.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the send_inter_thread_message function call.

function.name: send_internal_message_timeout
function.description: This function sends an internal message with a timeout. It checks if the destination thread is exiting or if it is the current thread. Depending on the conditions, it either handles the internal message directly or sends an inter-thread message.

parameters.name: dest_pid
parameters.description: The destination process ID

parameters.name: dest_tid
parameters.description: The destination thread ID

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be sent

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The flags to be used for the message

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout for the message

parameters.name: res_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the result

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the message send operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is non-zero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: send_hardware_message
function.description: This function sends a hardware message to the server. It handles different types of input such as mouse, keyboard, and hardware. The function also handles different flags and conditions.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that will receive the message.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The flags that specify various options.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: A pointer to an INPUT structure that contains the message to be sent.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: An additional message-specific information.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserPostQuitMessage
function.description: This function posts a quit message to the server with a specified exit code.

parameters.name: exit_code
parameters.description: This parameter represents the exit code that will be sent to the server.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the quit message was successfully posted or not. Always returns TRUE in this implementation.

function.name: NtUserDispatchMessage
function.description: This function dispatches a message to the window procedure. It processes timer messages, system timer messages, and paint messages. It also handles cases where the window handle is null or invalid.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the message to be dispatched.

function.return_type: LRESULT, which represents the result of the message processing. It returns 0 in case of failure or if the window handle is null.

function.name: is_message_broadcastable
function.description: Determines if a given message is broadcastable based on its value

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be checked for broadcastability

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the message is broadcastable, FALSE otherwise

function.name: broadcast_message
function.description: This function broadcasts a message to all window children. It checks if the message is broadcastable, gets the list of window children, and sends the message to each child window based on the message type. It also sets the value of res_ptr to 1 before returning.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing information about the message to be broadcasted, including the message, type, parameters, flags, timeout, callback, and data.

parameters.name: res_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD_PTR. If this pointer is not null, the function sets its value to 1.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function executed successfully. Always returns TRUE.

function.name: get_buffer
function.description: This function checks if the size is greater than or equal to the needed size. If it is, it returns the static buffer. Otherwise, it allocates memory of the needed size.

parameters.name: static_buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the static buffer

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The current size of the buffer

parameters.name: need
parameters.description: The needed size of the buffer

function.return_type: void * - Returns a pointer to the static buffer if the size is sufficient, otherwise returns a pointer to the newly allocated memory

function.name: free_buffer
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to the 'buffer' if it is not the same as 'static_buffer'.

parameters.name: static_buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a static buffer.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: test_lb_for_string
function.description: This function checks if a string can be used for a list box or combo box based on the style of the window and the message passed to it.

parameters.description: Handle to the window.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message to be processed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the string can be used for the list box or combo box.

function.return_type: CPTABLEINFO pointer, representing the code page table information for the current keyboard layout's default ANSI code page, or the ANSI code page if the default is UTF-8

parameters.name: wparam

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.description: This is the enumeration that defines the mapping from ANSI to Wide Char.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE after successful execution of the function.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: This is additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: This is additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a variable that receives the result of the message processing.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: This is an additional argument that can be used by the callback function.

parameters.name: mapping

function.name: process_message
function.description: This function processes a message by getting thread info, checking if it's a broadcast message, getting window thread, checking if it's an exiting thread, initializing window call parameters if conditions are met, and sending inter thread message or calling window proc based on conditions. It also handles message source and spy enter/exit messages.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the structure containing the message to be processed

parameters.name: res_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the result of the process

parameters.name: ansi

function.name: NtUserSetTimer
function.description: This function sets a timer for a window and an associated callback function to be invoked when the timer expires.

parameters.description: Handle to the window associated with the timer.

parameters.name: id

function.name: NtUserSetSystemTimer

parameters.description: A handle to the window associated with the timer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An identifier for the timer.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The time-out value, in milliseconds.

function.return_type: UINT_PTR, represents the identifier of the new timer. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserKillTimer

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: This is a handle to the window associated with the timer to be killed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: This is an identifier for the timer to be killed.

function.return_type: BOOL, where the return value is TRUE if the function succeeds, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtUserKillSystemTimer
function.description: This function is used to kill a system timer.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window associated with the system timer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the system timer.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the system timer was successfully killed or not.

parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be posted.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: wparam

function.name: NtUserTranslateMessage
function.description: This function translates virtual-key messages into character messages. The character messages are posted to the calling thread's message queue, to be read the next time the thread calls the GetMessage or PeekMessage function.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Pointer to an MSG structure that contains message information retrieved from the calling thread's message queue.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the behavior of the function. If this parameter is TRUE, the function performs the translation based on the WM_KEYDOWN or WM_KEYUP message. If this parameter is FALSE, the function translates the message and posts the character message to the calling thread's message queue.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the message is translated (that is, a character message is posted to the thread's message queue), the return value is TRUE. If the message is WM_KEYDOWN, WM_KEYUP, WM_SYSKEYDOWN, or WM_SYSKEYUP, the return value is TRUE, regardless of the translation. If the message is not translated (that is, a character message is not posted to the thread's message queue), the return value is FALSE.

function.name: NtUserGetCurrentInputMessageSource
function.description: This function retrieves the current input message source.
